title: File Upload Security: Antivirus Scanning and Temporary Files | Orchard Core
description:
A file that a user uploads is untrusted input, so it needs checking before it is stored.

An upload that calls FileCreationService reaches its handlers, and a handler such as the ClamAV Antivirus Scanner can reject the file before it is stored. Files that Orchard Core writes for a short time get their paths from ITempDirectoryProvider, in one tenant-scoped location that you configure.

In this video:
• How the upload pipeline checks a file before it is stored
• What the ClamAV Antivirus Scanner decides, and how to configure it
• Enabling the scanner, then uploading a clean file, a test file and a file while the scanner is stopped
• Running the pipeline and writing a handler in your own module
• Where temporary files go, and how to move them
